_what: The words and the ranking of tool:who-does-each-step (read-data/who-does.mjs). `words` are the sentences each answer says, with {holes}: a request may bring its own `words` over these. `ranking` is how much a past outcome (`met`, `failed`) moves a doer that covers the same need up or down. The doers and the reasons only a person can meet are never here: they come with each request.

words.one_tap: One tap and this is done for you: {doers}, about {cost}.
words.you: Only you can do this, because {reason}. The rest is done for you: {doers}.
words.you_alone: Only you can do this, because {reason}.
words.try_first: Your assistants try this first: {doers}. It reaches you only if they are stopped, and then they say exactly what stopped them.
words.nobody_yet: Nothing can do this yet ({needs}), so a doer for it is to be built. It is not on your list.
words.already_given: You already said yes ({given_in}), so this is done for you without asking again{with}.
words.summary: {trillion} done for you, {one_tap} one tap, {you} only you, {nobody_yet} to be built.
